This is the ONE live call GOR-245 specs.md § 4.4 permits (`anonymous: true`, read-only, no account, no quota); every other B6 fixture is synthetic and says so.

It identifies the recording call, not a session, but § 7.9 item 5 requires confirming no session-identifying value is committed, and a correlation id has no value to any consumer of this fixture. _capture.settlement_disclosure_decision: The `settlement` strings name real bank accounts (e.g. `BCEL · 010-12-00-0045821`, `National Treasury · 001-00-11-9000`). Recorded as PUBLIC CATALOGUE DATA, not a disclosure: the endpoint is unauthenticated, so the server publishes these to any anonymous caller on the open internet, and committing them discloses nothing that a `curl` does not already return without credentials. This is a decision, not an assumption — see security-review.md item 5.
